mapper.select: SELECT /* LGSYSC00210.retrieveMenuList */ m.* FROM ( SELECT ma.* FROM ( SELECT lmm.* , lfs.sort_order_no AS user_sort_order_no , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 1, 'Y', 'N') FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N WHERE program_id = lmm.program_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS user_manual_flag , pgm.system_code AS program_system_code , pgm.program_type_code , pgm.link_url_addr FROM ( SELECT common_code AS menu_id , common_code AS system_code , NULL AS module_code , NULL AS high_menu_id ,(SELECT common_code_name FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND common_code = lc.common_code AND language_code = 'en') AS menu_name , NULL AS menu_desc , NULL AS url_addr , NULL AS program_id , 0 AS menu_level_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lc WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND NVL(apply_start_date, SYSDATE) < (SYSDATE + 1) AND NVL(apply_end_date, SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE UNION SELECT a.menu_id , a.system_code , a.module_code , DECODE(a.menu_level_no, 1,a.system_code,a.high_menu_id) AS high_menu_id , lmm.menu_name , a.menu_desc , a.url_addr , a.program_id , a.menu_level_no FROM LGCOM_MENU_M a , LGCOM_MENU_MULTI_LANG_N lmm , ( SELECT role_code, org_id, menu_id FROM ( SELECT a.role_code , NULL AS org_id , b.menu_id FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N a , LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N b WHERE a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND a.role_code = b.role_code AND NVL(apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N WHERE organization_type_code = 'C' AND role_code = a.role_code) UNION SELECT a.role_code , b.company_id AS org_id , c.menu_id FROM LGCOM_USER_ROLE_N a , LGCOM_ROLE_BIZ_ORG_N b , LGCOM_ROLE_MENU_N c WHERE a.role_code = b.role_code AND a.role_code = c.role_code AND a.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AND NVL(a.apply_start_date,SYSDATE) <= SYSDATE AND NVL(a.apply_end_date,SYSDATE) >= SYSDATE AND b.organization_type_code = 'C' ) WHERE (org_id IS NULL OR org_id = #{USER_SESSION.defaultOrgId}) ) b WHERE a.menu_id = b.menu_id AND a.menu_id = lmm.menu_id AND lmm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND a.display_flag = 'Y' ) lmm , LGCOM_FULL_SYSTEM_FAVOR_HIER_N lfs , LGCOM_PROGRAM_M pgm WHERE lmm.menu_id = lfs.menu_id AND lmm.program_id = pgm.program_id(+) AND lfs.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ) ma START WITH ma.menu_level_no = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR ma.menu_id = ma.high_menu_id ORDER SIBLINGS BY ma.user_sort_order_no, ma.menu_name ) m WHERE m.menu_level_no <> 0

SELECT /*LGSYSC00210.retrieveMenuInfo*/ LMM.MENU_ID, LMM.MENU_NAME, LMM.SYSTEM_CODE, LMM.MODULE_CODE, LMM.HIGH_MENU_ID, LMM.MENU_DESC, LMM.MENU_LEVEL_NO, LMM.SORT_ORDER_NO, LMM.PROGRAM_ID FROM LGCOM_MENU_M LMM WHERE LMM.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND LMM.MENU_ID = #{menuId}

SELECT /* LGSYSC00210.retrieveMenuListByRole */ user_menu_yn ,(SELECT DECODE(COUNT(1), 1, 'Y', 'N') FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N um WHERE program_id = men.program_id AND ROWNUM = 1) AS user_manual_flag , application_user_id , menu_id , menu_name , system_code , module_code , high_menu_id , program_id , program_system_code , program_module_code , program_type_code , link_url_addr , menu_desc , menu_level_no , sort_order_no , menu_order_by FROM (SELECT DECODE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM LGCOM_FULL_SYSTEM_FAVOR_HIER_N WHERE application_user_id = lu.application_user_id AND menu_id = lu.menu_id),1,'Y','N') AS user_menu_yn , application_user_id , menu_id , menu_name , system_code , module_code , high_menu_id , program_id , program_system_code , program_module_code , program_type_code , link_url_addr , menu_desc , menu_level_no , sort_order_no , menu_order_by FROM LGCOM_USER_MENU_INFO_V lu WHERE lu.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lu.system_code = UPPER( #{USER_SESSION.systemCode} ) /* Session 에 있는 기본 시스템 정보를 활용한다. */ AND lu.application_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} ) men ORDER BY menu_order_by

SELECT /*LGSYSC00210.retrieveTop10ListForMain*/ fav.menu_id ,mmm.menu_name ,men.program_id FROM lgcom_system_user_favorites_n fav ,lgcom_menu_m men ,lgcom_menu_multi_lang_n mmm WHERE fav.menu_id = men.menu_id AND fav.favorites_creation_class_code in ( 'USER_SYSTEM_FAVORITE' ) AND fav.system_code = UPPER( #{USER_SESSION.systemCode} ) AND men.menu_id = mmm.menu_id AND mmm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} ORDER BY fav.sort_order_no

SELECT 'USER' AS item_type ,COUNT(DISTINCT lsa.application_user_id) item_count FROM lgcom_system_access_logging_n lsa ,lgcom_user_m lu WHERE lsa.application_user_id = lu.application_user_id AND lsa.access_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND lsa.access_date < SYSDATE + 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'ROLE' AS ITEM_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM LGCOM_ROLE_M WHERE NVL( TO_CHAR(APPLY_END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'), '9999-12-31') > TO_CHAR( SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) UNION ALL SELECT 'PROGRAM' AS ITEM_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_M WHERE USE_FLAG = 'Y'
SELECT COMMON_CODE AS "CODE", CODE_DATA1_VALUE AS "NAME" FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE CODE_TYPE_CODE = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE'
SELECT SM_NAME AS "NAME", PI_OFFICE_PHONE_NUMBER AS "PHONE" FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_CONTACT_USER_V

SELECT /* LGSYSC00210.selectAttachmentListByReqNumber */ file_id, file_group_id, system_code, module_code, file_name, file_desc, file_size, file_location_info, #{downloadURL} || '/common/' || file_id AS download_url FROM lgcom_attach_file_info WHERE file_group_id = #{fileGroupId} ORDER BY file_id
SELECT /* LGSYSC00210.selectExcelUploadErrorCountForLgcom */ COUNT(session_id) AS error_count FROM LGCOM_IMPORT_N WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND attribute199 = 'Y' AND seq_no <> '1'

SELECT lcc.code_data1_value system_code ,NVL( SUM(DECODE(item_type, 'USER', NVL(item_count, 0))), 0) AS "User" ,NVL( SUM(DECODE(item_type, 'ROLE', NVL(item_count, 0))), 0) AS "Role" ,NVL( SUM(DECODE(item_type, 'PROGRAM', NVL(item_count, 0))), 0) AS "Program" FROM (SELECT lu.system_code ,'USER' AS item_type ,COUNT(DISTINCT lsa.application_user_id) item_count FROM lgcom_system_access_logging_n lsa ,lgcom_user_m lu WHERE lsa.application_user_id = lu.application_user_id AND lsa.access_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND lsa.access_date < SYSDATE + 1 GROUP BY lu.system_code UNION ALL SELECT system_code ,'ROLE' AS item_type ,COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lgcom_role_m WHERE NVL(TO_CHAR(apply_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '9999-12-31') > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY system_code UNION ALL SELECT system_code ,'PROGRAM' AS item_type ,COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lgcom_program_m WHERE use_flag = 'Y' GROUP BY system_code) ldata ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE ldata.system_code = lcc.common_code AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' GROUP BY lcc.code_data1_value ,lcc.sort_order_no ORDER BY lcc.sort_order_no
